انعزلوا (form VII)
# اِنْعَزَلُوا (inʕazalū) /in.ʕa.za.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْعَزَلَ (inʕazala)
# اِنْعَزِلُوا (inʕazilū) /in.ʕa.zi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْعَزَلَ (inʕazala)
